checks.exact_question: During attrition, how does an office roll resolve, what extra modifier does the Chairman have, and where do a retiring member, card and fatigue go?

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: how does an office roll resolve
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: **Attrition:** Simultaneously roll one die for each held office card. Add one per fatigue on that card; Chairman also adds one. Modified 1–2: nothing; 3–4: add fatigue; 5+: retire.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: what extra modifier does the Chairman have
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Add one per fatigue on that card; Chairman also adds one.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: where do a retiring member, card and fatigue go
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Move retiree to Pensioners, flip card into Vacant Offices, return its fatigue to supply.

checks.exact_question: Who may select London Season cards, in what order and with which tiebreakers? What happens to the display and unused pensioners afterward?

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: Who may select London Season cards
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Players who completed at least one pensioner retirement **or an eligible firm special retirement during this London Season** must each take or discard one display card

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: in what order and with which tiebreakers
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: in descending actual total retirement spending. A firm special retirement uses a supply member instead of a pensioner but otherwise counts as a normal retirement for this selection; each eligible player still selects only one card. Ties: most total windows, including new prizes, then clockwise from PM.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: What happens to the display and unused pensioners afterward
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Finish the display step by **discarding all remaining cards and refilling exactly three: prestige faceup, blackmail facedown, even if nobody took a card**. Return all remaining Pensioners to their supplies.

checks.exact_question: How do the opportunity marker and extra-action laws affect family actions? If four offices are vacant and the marker already sits on Enlist Writer, how many writers can be placed?

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: How do the opportunity marker and extra-action laws affect family actions
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Choose a main family action: take it once, or **may take it twice if the marker already matched it**. **Place/move the opportunity marker onto your chosen main action.** After the main action, only the latest passed extra-action law may grant its extra action. This extra action is never doubled by the marker and never moves the marker.
asked_clause_ledger.missing_clause: How do the opportunity marker and extra-action laws affect family actions
asked_clause_ledger.contradiction_or_repair: Quote not found in declared source unit.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: If four offices are vacant and the marker already sits on Enlist Writer, how many writers can be placed
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: With at least four vacant offices, place one additional writer **once this turn**, so a doubled Writer action can place three total.

checks.exact_question: After Seek Share actions, how are new Company shares created and remaining applicants moved? Where was the initial purchase money paid?

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: how are new Company shares created
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: After all family actions, if Debt and applicants remain, move the rightmost applicant into Court and lower Debt by one. Repeat while both remain.
With no Debt, slide remaining applicants as far right as possible, preserving order.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: Where was the initial purchase money paid
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Place a member on an empty Stock Exchange space and pay bank: the five queue spaces are £2, £3, £3, £4, £5 (two distinct £3 spaces).

checks.exact_question: When hiring, how are vacancies ordered, what consent does hiring your own family require, what happens to promoted fatigue, and what if no candidate or hirer exists?

asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Fill vacant offices in ascending number on their card backs.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: what consent does hiring your own family require
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: Own-family hiring needs verbal consent from every other player in that office's candidate pool
When promoting an officeholder, transfer its fatigue to the new card and insert its old card, vacant, into ascending hiring order.

asked_clause_ledger.requested_clause: what if no candidate or hirer exists
asked_clause_ledger.actual_supplied_fact_or_result: If no candidate exists, or the hirer is vacant, skip the office; it stays vacant and takes no actions, including hiring.
